identificationModule.briefTitle: Fruquintinib With mFOLFOX6/FOLFIRI as First-Line Therapy for Conversion Surgery in mCRC
identificationModule.officialTitle: Fruquintinib With mFOLFOX6/FOLFIRI as First-Line Therapy for Conversion Surgery in mCRC: An Exploratory Clinical Trial

descriptionModule.briefSummary:
The goal of this clinical trial is to learn about the efficacy and safety of Fruquintinib with mFOLFOX6/FOLFIRI in patients with mCRC. The main question it aims to answer is:

The conversion surgery rate of the therapy mentioned above. The ORR, R0 surgery rate, DCR, PFS, OS, and safety will be evaluated.

interventions.name: Fruquintinib+mFOLFOX6/FOLFIRI
interventions.description: Fruquintinib: 4mg po qd, d1-d21, q4w with mFOLFOX6/FOLFIRI (standard)

primaryOutcomes.description: Objective Response Rate: The proportion of participants in the analyzed population who developed complete (CR) or partial response (PR) according to RECIST 1.1 criteria.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: through study completion, an average of 2 year

secondaryOutcomes.description: R0 Surgery Rate: R0 corresponds to resection for cure or complete remission.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: through study completion, an average of 2 year

secondaryOutcomes.description: Disease Control Rate: The proportion of subjects in the analyzed population who achieved CR, PR, or stable disease (SD) according to RECIST 1.1 criteria.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: through study completion, an average of 2 year

secondaryOutcomes.description: Progression-Free Survival: Time from patient admission to first radiographic disease progression (RECIST 1.1 criteria) or death (whichever occurs first).
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: through study completion, an average of 2 year

secondaryOutcomes.description: Overall Survival: From the time of patient admission to the time of subject's death, at the end of the study, if the subject is still alive, the last known date of subject's survival is the deletion date.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: through study completion, an average of 2 year
